questions.question: What is India's ranking in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**151st.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India ranks 151st in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index, showing a slight improvement from 159th in 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India ranks 151st in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index, improving from 159th in 2024.**
 
• The report highlights significant threats to press freedom in India, including financial instability among media outlets.
 
• Many media outlets in India have shut down due to economic hardship, further limiting press freedom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• World Press Freedom Index__

 __
 
• The World Press Freedom Index is compiled by Reporters Without Borders, evaluating the press freedom situation in 180 countries.
 
• It measures the degree of freedom available to journalists in each country and the dangers they face in reporting the news.
 
 
 
• Press Freedom Threats__
 
 
• Press freedom faces significant challenges globally, including economic pressures, violence against journalists, and government censorship.

questions.question: Which organisation released the report “Economic Outlook for Southeast Asia, China and India: Enhancing Disaster Risk Financing 2025”?

options.text: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) released the “Economic Outlook for Southeast Asia, China and India: Enhancing Disaster Risk Financing 2025” report.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The report is a regular OECD publication analysing Asia’s regional economic growth and development trends.**
 
• This edition focuses on enhancing disaster risk financing in Emerging Asia, including India, China, and ASEAN-11 countries.
 
• Emerging Asian economies face increasing natural disasters in terms of frequency and intensity.
 
• India faces major risks from floods and storms and has suffered average annual disaster-related losses of 0.4% of GDP between 1990 and 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Report Focus__

 __
 
• Examines economic conditions of ASEAN member countries along with China and India.
 
• Highlights the need for stronger disaster risk financing mechanisms.
 
 
 
• Disaster Risk in Asia__
 __
 
• India: Floods and storms are primary disaster risks.
 
• Philippines and Vietnam: Frequently impacted by tropical cyclones.
 
 
 
• World Risk Index__
 __
 
• India ranks second among Asian economies in the World Risk Index.
 
• Philippines ranks highest, reflecting extreme vulnerability to natural disasters.
 
 
 
• Significance__
 
 
• Supports evidence-based policy planning for disaster resilience.
 
• Encourages financial preparedness to reduce economic losses from disasters.

questions.question: Which of the following statements with respect to NITI Aayog’s Trade Watch Quarterly (Q1 FY 2025–26) is incorrect?

options.text: Services exports recorded a year-on-year growth of nearly 11 per cent in Q1 FY26
The overall trade deficit in Q1 FY26 was lower than that of Q1 FY24
Total trade during Q1 FY26 declined compared to the corresponding quarter of FY24
India’s total merchandise exports grew by 1.92 per cent year-on-year in Q1 FY26

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Total trade during Q1 FY26 declined compared to the corresponding quarter of FY24.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **NITI Aayog released the fifth edition of Trade Watch Quarterly, assessing India’s trade performance for Q1 FY 2025–26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Total trade during Q1 FY 2025–26 increased to USD 210.31 billion, registering a growth of 5.94 per cent year-on-year.**
 
• Merchandise exports stood at USD 112.17 billion, growing 1.92 per cent compared to Q1 FY24.
 
• Services exports rose sharply to USD 98.13 billion, recording a robust 10.93 per cent growth.
 
• Incorrect Statement Explained__ 
 __
 
• Total trade did not decline in Q1 FY26
 
• It increased from USD 198.52 billion in Q1 FY24 to USD 210.31 billion
 
• This reflects overall expansion in India’s trade activity
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Trade Watch Quarterly__

 __
 
• Flagship analytical publication of NITI Aayog
 
• Provides quarterly assessment of India’s trade performance
 
• Covers merchandise trade, services trade and overall trends
 
 
 
• Trade Deficit__
 __
 
• Q1 FY26 trade deficit stood at USD 20.31 billion
 
• Improved from USD 22.42 billion in Q1 FY24
 
• Reflects higher export growth relative to imports
 
 
 
• Imports Performance__
 
 
• Total imports reached USD 230.62 billion
 
• Registered a 4.38 per cent year-on-year increase
 
• Driven by demand for energy, capital goods and intermediates

questions.question: How much percentage growth has the Asian Development Bank (ADB) forecast for India for the financial year 2025–26 in its latest Asia and Pacific Growth Outlook report?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7.2 percent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has raised India’s GDP growth forecast to 7.2 percent for FY 2025–26 in its Asia and Pacific Growth Outlook report.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The revised forecast of 7.2 percent marks an increase from the earlier estimate of 6.5 percent.**
 
• **The upward revision is attributed to robust performance in the July–September quarter.**
 
• **ADB kept its FY 2026–27 forecast unchanged at 6.5 percent.**
 
• **ADB projected the Asia–Pacific region’s economic growth at 5.1 percent for the current year.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Asian Development Bank (ADB)**__

 __
 
• Headquarters: Manila, Philippines.
 
• President: Masato Kanda.
 
• Established in 1966 as a regional development bank to promote economic and social progress in Asia–Pacific.
 
 
 
• **GDP Forecast**__
 
 
• Represents the expected economic growth rate for a country in a financial year.
 
• Revisions reflect changing economic conditions, performance indicators and policy impacts.

questions.question: Which city topped India's pollution chart in November 2025, according to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air report?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghaziabad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **A think tank report found Ghaziabad to be the most polluted city in India in November 2025.**
 
• **It topped the pollution chart among the top 10 polluted cities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghaziabad recorded a monthly average PM2.5 concentration of 224 µg/m³.**
 
• **It remained above the national air quality standard on all 30 days.**
 
• **UP accounted for six of the top 10 polluted cities, including Ghaziabad.**
 
• **Delhi ranked fourth with 215 µg/m³ PM2.5 concentration.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PM2.5**__ – Fine particulate matter of size 2.5 micrometers, harmful for health when elevated.
 
• __**CREA**__ – Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air, the think tank that released the report.
 
• Except Bahadurgarh, none of the top 10 cities recorded even a single day within safe air quality limits.
 
• Shillong was the cleanest city with PM2.5 at 7 µg/m³, while Karnataka had six among the top cleanest cities.

questions.question: Which state has the highest number of schools with zero enrollment according to the UDISE+ Report for 2023-24?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The UDISE+ Report for 2023-24 highlighted an increase in schools with zero enrollment across India, totaling 12,954.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Bengal has the largest number of schools with zero enrollment at 3,254, followed by Rajasthan (2,167) and Telangana (**2,167**).**
 
• The total number of zero-enrollment schools increased by 2,660 compared to the previous year.
 
• **Single-teacher schools in India dropped by 7,219 in 2023-24, now totaling 1,10,971, with MP having the most such schools.**
 
• States are considering closing such schools if no new enrollments occur in the next year.
 
• Zero-enrollment schools often retain sanctioned teacher posts despite no active students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Unified District Information System for Education Plus (UDISE+)__

 __
 
• It is a government database providing insights into India's education system.
 
• Focuses on tracking enrollment, infrastructure, and educational trends annually.
 
 
 
• Zero Enrollment Schools__
 
 
• Schools with no student enrollments during the academic year.
 
• Reasons include lack of interest, migration, or the completion of the last batch of students.

questions.question: What is India's rank in the World Happiness Report 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**118th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India ranks 118th in the World Happiness Report 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India ranks 118th out of 147 countries in the World Happiness Report 2025.**
 
• **Finland is ranked as the world's happiest country** for the eighth consecutive year, followed by Denmark, Iceland, and others.
 
• India's highest rank was 94 in 2022 and its lowest was 144 in 2012.
 
• The report evaluates happiness based on six key factors: social support, GDP per capita, healthy life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and perception of corruption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• World Happiness Report - A yearly publication by the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network that ranks countries based on happiness levels.__
 
• __Factors Influencing Happiness - Social support, GDP per capita, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity, and perception of corruption.__

questions.question: Which organization has released the "Education and Nutrition: Learn to Eat Well" report, which has urged better nutrition in school meals?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**UNESCO.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **UNESCO released the report titled "Education and Nutrition: Learn to Eat Well" during the "Nutrition for Growth" event held in France in March 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• UNESCO's report emphasizes the need to improve the nutritional quality of school meals globally.
 
• As of 2024, 47% of primary school pupils globally benefit from school meals, but many meals lack proper nutrition.
 
• Only 27% of school meals involved nutritionists in 2022; laws exist in just 93 of 187 countries.
 
• The report calls for the integration of nutrition education into school curricula.
 
• UNESCO encourages schools to prioritize fresh, locally sourced food while reducing processed foods in meals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Brazil__

 __
 
• Brazil's National School Feeding Program limits ultra-processed foods in school meals.
 
 
 
• China__
 __
 
• China introduced dairy and vegetables in rural school meals to enhance nutritional value.
 
 
 
• Nigeria__
 __
 
• Nigeria's Home-Grown School Feeding Programme increased primary school enrollment by 20%.
 
 
 
• India__
 
 
• India used fortified organic pearl millet to improve cognitive functions among adolescents.
